gaps.sentence: The divers ___ (know) to have been working without insurance.
gaps.explanation: are known to have been working: the knowing is present, the working was ongoing before.

gaps.sentence: Guests ___ to arrive no later than seven.
gaps.explanation: Guests receive the request: present simple passive are + asked.

gaps.sentence: We're having the kitchen ___ (renovate) next month.
gaps.explanation: Causative 'have something done': have + object + past participle. Professionals do it for us.
Past simple passive: was + demolished. The demolition company is not mentioned.

gaps.sentence: The debt ___ (repay) in full by May, he promised.
gaps.explanation: Reported future passive: would be + past participle after a past reporting verb.

gaps.sentence: The two leaders ___ (report) to have reached a provisional agreement.
gaps.explanation: Plural subject needs are: are reported to have reached (perfect infinitive for the earlier event).

gaps.sentence: Thousands of homes ___ (flood) when the river burst its banks.
gaps.explanation: Past simple passive: were + flooded. The cause (the river) is in the when-clause.

gaps.sentence: The results ___ (publish) on the university website next Friday.
gaps.explanation: Future simple passive: will be + past participle. 'Next Friday' fixes the future reference.
